A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''enslaver''' was in the employ of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong|Koong]] of [[Tawntoom]] Province on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the slavedriver oversaw a [[Boat/Legends|galley]] full of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and forced them to row across the [[Roon Sea]] to [[Koong Island]]. Nevertheless, the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] sneaked aboard the boat at night and freed the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]]. The slavedriver was incapacitated in the ensuing mass escape.
